What to Prepare Before They Arrive:

Water & Power Access: Most mobile detailers bring their own water and power via generators, but it's always best to confirm if they will need to plug into an outdoor outlet or use your spigot.

Clear the Car: Remove all personal items, trash, and valuables from the cabin and trunk prior to their arrival so they can focus entirely on deep cleaning and extraction.

Parking Space: Ensure you have a safe, relatively flat space (like a driveway or wide street parking) where the technician can easily set up their equipment around your vehicle.
